question.text: Let <math><msub><mrow><mi>C</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub></math> be the graph of <math><mi>x</mi><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></math> and the reflection of <math><msub><mrow><mi>C</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub></math> in the line <math><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi></math> is <math><msub><mrow><mi>C</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mo>.</mo></math> If the equation of <math><msub><mrow><mi>C</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math> is expressed as <math><mn>12</mn><msup><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>b</mi><mi>x</mi><mi>y</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>c</mi><msup><mrow><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>d</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>, then the value of <math><mo>(</mo><mi>b</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>c</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>d</mi><mo>)</mo></math> is equal to

solution.text:
Any point on the hyperbola xy=1 is t,1t
Now, the image of t,1t by the line mirror y=2x is
x-t2=y-1t-1=-22t-1t5
⇒5x=4t-3t and 5y=4t+3t
Now eliminating t from above two equations we get,
12x2-12y2-7xy+25=0
∴b+c+d=6
